news.title: Dispute leads to 1 being stabbed in Atlanta: police
news.summary: It happened Monday afternoon in the Adamsville neighborhood.

news.title: Scooter rider in coma after impatient driver passes on wrong side, family says
news.summary: The man was riding a scooter home from work just before 6 p.m. on Sept. 1 when the crash happened at Arc Way and Willow Wood Way, according to a Gwinnett County police crash report.

news.title: MARTA bus crashes in Dunwoody; 3 injured
news.summary: A MARTA bus crashed along a Dunwoody intersection Monday, leaving three people reporting injuries.

news.title: Family of Atlanta police recruit killed says becoming an officer was 'a calling'
news.summary: 24-year-old Moses Russ died last Tuesday while on his way to realizing a life goal: becoming an Atlanta police officer.

news.title: Man shot in groin on Piedmont Avenue following dispute
news.summary: A verbal dispute turned violent late Sunday night on Piedmont Avenue, leaving a man hospitalized with a gunshot wound to his groin, according to Atlanta police.

news.title: Slain Georgia officer will be laid to rest Tuesday
news.summary: A law enforcement procession and funeral services are set for Tuesday in Fayetteville following the deadly shooting of Warm Springs Sgt. Christopher Fisher.

news.title: K9 escapes burning car, pulls victims from fatal metro Atlanta crash
news.summary: A 19-year-old man died early Monday after a Georgia State Patrol vehicle collided with a pickup truck while responding to illegal stunt driving in metro Atlanta

news.title: Shooting in Buford leaves 1 dead, 2 injured during armed robbery, police say
news.summary: A man is dead and two are injured in a Buford shooting, Gwinnett Police report.
